ticket.subject: Multi-currency support
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

Could you support several currencies per workspace?

We sell in the US and in Europe. Our reports would need to convert amounts at a fixed monthly rate. Right now we keep two separate workspaces.

Please consider it.

Kind regards,
Dana
